findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the agreement without cause, while you do not have a reciprocal right.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon ninety (90) days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.
findings.explanation: Your indemnification and IP-infringement obligations under Section 9 are excluded from the liability cap, leaving your exposure for those claims completely uncapped.
findings.suggested_change: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars, including any claims under Section 9 hereof.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request one adjustment before signing. - Under the relevant clause, certain obligations are excluded from the liability cap, leaving exposure for those claims uncapped. I propose updating the agreement with the following change: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars, including any claims under Section 9 hereof. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards
